raw.query: WITH current_eda AS (SELECT e.* FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.eda_metric e ON e.run_id = d.run_id WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND d.experiment = 'eda'), cv AS (SELECT window_bin, MAX(value_num) FILTER (WHERE signal = 'images') AS images_cv2, MAX(value_num) FILTER (WHERE signal = 'ctx') AS ctx_cv2, MAX(value_num) FILTER (WHERE signal = 'gen') AS gen_cv2, MAX(value_num) FILTER (WHERE signal = 'requests') AS requests_cv2 FROM current_eda WHERE run_id = 'eda:q_multires_tails' AND stat = 'cv2' GROUP BY window_bin), visibility AS (SELECT MAX(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 'pearson_1min.img_vs_req') AS image_request_pearson_1min, MAX(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 'constant_fraction_fit.r2') AS request_rate_fit_r2 FROM current_eda WHERE run_id = 'eda:d_signals') SELECT COUNT(*) AS resolutions_checked, BOOL_AND(images_cv2 > GREATEST(ctx_cv2, gen_cv2, requests_cv2)) AS images_bursty_at_every_resolution, MAX(images_cv2) FILTER (WHERE window_bin = '60s') AS images_cv2_60s, MAX(ctx_cv2) FILTER (WHERE window_bin = '60s') AS ctx_cv2_60s, MAX(gen_cv2) FILTER (WHERE window_bin = '60s') AS gen_cv2_60s, MAX(requests_cv2) FILTER (WHERE window_bin = '60s') AS requests_cv2_60s, v.image_request_pearson_1min, v.request_rate_fit_r2 FROM cv CROSS JOIN visibility v GROUP BY v.image_request_pearson_1min, v.request_rate_fit_r2
raw.observed: Images had the highest CV² at all 19 checked resolutions; at 60s: images 3.830446712427293, context 0.8528279398833853, generation 0.39509177090379655, requests 0.32115747680000006. Image/request correlation was 0.3546002012649865 and request-rate fit R² was 0.12253911262014872.
raw.claimed: the vision pool's image rate: the burstiest of the four, nearly invisible in the request rate a conventional autoscaler watches
raw.evidence: Current, non-superseded EDA data ranks image rate as the burstiest signal at every checked resolution and shows request rate explains little image-rate variation.
